topic.title: AI Functionality
topic.shortdesc: AI-assisted features are available in to support writing, editing, and content improvement tasks.

body.p: When AI-assisted features are enabled, users with the Author platform user role or Contributor platform user role can use them to support content creation and refinement. These features are intended to help with writing tasks, content improvement, and other authoring activities.
In , AI functionality is available through AI Positron. Availability depends on the product setup and the assigned platform user role.

p.note: AI Positron is only available if an administrator has integrated it in the organization's Content Fusion server.

section.title: Prerequisites
section.p:
For Contributors to have access to AI features, the following is required:
AI support must be enabled for the organization.
The organization must have AI credits available.
The contributor must not have reached their individual monthly AI limit.

section.title: Availability
section.p: AI functionality is intended for users with the Author platform user role or Contributor platform user role. It may also depend on whether the feature is enabled and configured in the current environment.
